# Migration Requirements Quality Checklist: Complete Data Model Migration

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of the SPEC-0004 migration requirements (spec, plan, research, data-model, contracts) before implementation
**Created**: 2026-08-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items test the **requirements themselves** (unit tests for requirements writing), not the implementation.
